hero.title: Kalasalingam Academy of Research and Education
hero.summary: Kalasalingam’s agriculture school at Krishnankoil connects crop science with a teaching farm, irrigation equipment and subject laboratories. Its bachelor’s curriculum spans production, crop improvement, resource management, economics and extension, giving students a broad agricultural foundation within the academy’s wider science and engineering setting.

overview.heading: Agriculture teaching in the Krishnankoil setting
paragraphs: KARE’s published agriculture curriculum links crop production and improvement with natural resources, agricultural economics and extension. The 2022 syllabus provides a detailed academic reference for prospective students who want to examine course content beyond a programme title.

The Kalasalingam Anandammal Farm gives the school a practical setting for crop work. The course page identifies fertigation equipment and implements including a tractor, cultivator, disc plough and rotary tiller, alongside nine subject laboratories. Together, these facilities connect the curriculum’s biological and resource-management subjects with cultivation and machinery. KARE’s institutional history begins with an engineering college in 1984 and records university status from 2006.

admissions.heading: Applying to KARE
admissions.intro: The university publishes agriculture-specific eligibility and selection information within its admissions page. The course and central pages differ in detail, so request the applying-year subject and marks requirements.

placements.heading: Career support and outcomes
placements.text: The university's NIRF 2026 Agriculture and Allied Sectors submission reports graduates, placements, higher-study progression and the median annual salary of placed graduates for the cohorts below. faqs.question: Where is KARE’s agriculture school?
faqs.answer: Its 2022 curriculum gives Krishnankoil in Virudhunagar district as the address.

faqs.question: Which course does this ICAR record cover?
faqs.answer: B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture under Kalasalingam School of Agriculture and Horticulture.

faqs.question: What is the accreditation term?
faqs.answer: The audited term runs from 26 September 2024 to 25 September 2029.

faqs.question: What year does the quoted fee belong to?
faqs.answer: The ₹1,20,000 annual programme amount is from the official 2025-2026 table, with additional charges listed separately.

faqs.question: Is horticulture automatically covered by this agriculture record?
faqs.answer: No. The audited row here names the agriculture degree only.

faqs.question: What practical farm equipment is documented?
faqs.answer: The course page lists implements including a tractor and rotary tiller at the farm.

faqs.question: Are verified agriculture placement figures available?
faqs.answer: The NIRF 2026 agriculture/allied submission reports UG four-year programmes (2024-2025): 66 placed from 119 graduates in minimum time, with ₹3,50,000 median annual salary among those placed. These are historical group-level outcomes, not specialisation-level placement promises.
